claims.subject: Pacific Coach Lines
claims.finding: Pacific Coach Lines began operations, replacing Pacific Stage Lines and Vancouver Island Coach Lines.
claims.limit: This is an operational start, not a proven incorporation or public-acquisition date.

claims.subject: Pacific Coach Lines
claims.finding: The planned replacement of the two bus services was announced.

claims.subject: Pacific Coach Lines
claims.finding: The 1984/85 Public Accounts state that operations ceased on this date and winding up was still in progress.
claims.limit: Do not treat the cessation date as a legal dissolution date.

claims.subject: Pacific Coach Lines
claims.finding: The 1985/86 accounts describe continued disposal of remaining real estate following the termination of operations.
claims.limit: An accounting checkpoint for wind-down activity, not an exact legal end date.

name_caution: The Hydro description of provincially owned Vancouver Island Coach Lines does not establish identity with Vancouver Island Transit or Vancouver Island Transportation; the 1978 T.S. accounts list these names separately.
